company.description:
emz-Hanauer: „Smart Solutions“ for the global market

75 years of emz – family-owned, globally connected.

Founded by Ernst Hanauer in the Upper Palatinate in 1948, emz-Hanauer GmbH & Co. KGaA has grown into a global technology partner – still family-run, still rooted in its values.

Our headquarters is located in Nabburg, Bavaria – with additional sites in Zangenstein (Germany), the Czech Republic, Romania, Mexico and China.
Over 1,600 colleagues worldwide work on intelligent components for household appliances: door locks, sensors, electric actuators and LED modules – used in dishwashers, washing machines, dryers and refrigerators.

In locking systems and sensor technology, we are proud to be the global market leader – and to have more than doubled our revenue in the last decade.

We're also shaping the future in building and waste management technology, with a strong focus on digitalization and IoT.

What makes us special?
Flat hierarchies, freedom to decide, and a culture built on respect, fairness and joy at work.
Because we believe: success is built by people who feel at home in what they do.

Feel free to reach out – we’d love to hear from you!
